description: review §P2-21: application-level ACL. Unprefixed permission references resolve against the __app-acl__ manifest built from acl/app-permissions.json (one allow-<command> permission per generate_handler! command, grouped into app-* sets). The exact same SPA bundle (desktop/ui) runs in the main window and in every session-* window (session windows boot /?windowSession=<uuid> and render the full UI), so both window groups need the same command surface today; window/origin scoping is the point of this capability — any other window label, nested frame, or remote origin resolves to no capability and is denied. Maintained together with desktop/tests/app_command_acl_coverage.rs, which fails when a command is added to generate_handler! without an ACL entry.
